description: Mediums, what a What can be passed over, and Mediations: the stack of Mediums a Connection is passed over, from the top down, each optionally realized by a Transformation down into the Medium's Language and one up out of it. A Mediation states only that its What passes over the Medium; how is the realization's, which belongs to the Deployment whose layout has the Connection — never to its ends, which do not know how they are connected. A Component exports its Mediums as it does its other parts. Optional. Extends Deployment.

axioms.about: A Medium's call is an Interaction of the Component that defines it
axioms.formula: all m in Medium. m.call.component == m.component

axioms.about: A Medium's call is over the Medium's Language
axioms.formula: all m in Medium. m.call.language == m.language

axioms.about: An Export of a Medium exports nothing else
axioms.formula: all e in Export. some e.medium => no e.component and no e.interaction and no e.transformation and no e.language and no e.deployment and no e.instance
all e in Export. some e.component or some e.interaction or some e.transformation or some e.language or some e.medium or some e.deployment or some e.instance

axioms.about: A Component exports only its own Mediums
axioms.formula: all e in Export, x in e.medium. x.component == e.exporter

axioms.about: A Mediation is over a Medium its Connection's Deployment has access to
axioms.formula: all m in Mediation, d in m.connection.deployment. m.how.component in d.component.*parent or m.how.component in d.keeper.*parent or m.how in d.imports.exports.medium

axioms.about: A realization goes down into the Medium's Language
axioms.formula: all m in Mediation, d in m.down, o in d.output. o.language in m.how.language.*extends

axioms.about: A realization comes up from the Medium's Language
axioms.formula: all m in Mediation, u in m.up, p in u.parameters. p.type.language in m.how.language.*extends

axioms.about: The top Mediation's realization goes down from its Connection's What
axioms.formula: all m in Mediation, d in m.down, p in d.parameters, i in m.connection.what. no m.above => p.type.language in i.language.*extends

axioms.about: The top Mediation's realization comes up to its Connection's What
axioms.formula: all m in Mediation, u in m.up, o in u.output, i in m.connection.what. no m.above => o.language in i.language.*extends

axioms.about: A lower Mediation's realization goes down from the Medium above it
axioms.formula: all m in Mediation, a in m.above, d in m.down, p in d.parameters. p.type.language in a.how.language.*extends

axioms.about: A lower Mediation's realization comes up to the Medium above it
axioms.formula: all m in Mediation, a in m.above, u in m.up, o in u.output. o.language in a.how.language.*extends

axioms.about: A Mediation's below is a Mediation of the same Connection
axioms.formula: all m in Mediation, b in m.below. b.connection == m.connection

axioms.about: A Connection's Mediations have one top
axioms.formula: all c in Connection, a in c.mediations, b in c.mediations. (no a.above and no b.above) => a == b

axioms.about: The Mediation stack has no cycles
axioms.formula: all m in Mediation. not m in m.^below

axioms.about: A realization's way down is accessible to its Connection's Deployment
axioms.formula: all m in Mediation, t in m.down, d in m.connection.deployment. t.component in d.component.*parent or t.component in d.keeper.*parent or t in d.imports.exports.transformation

axioms.about: A realization's way up is accessible to its Connection's Deployment
axioms.formula: all m in Mediation, t in m.up, d in m.connection.deployment. t.component in d.component.*parent or t.component in d.keeper.*parent or t in d.imports.exports.transformation
